title: proved-answers-the-chart
intention: THE EXIT GATE — the loop's other hand. At the emit chokepoint, a cast ticket's forward crossing into PROVED REFUSES unless the voyage ANSWERS its chart: every criterion in the berthed validate packet that claims the ticket carries a run verdict (instrument run, outcome recorded in a durable verdict artifact the gate can shape-check), and every hypothesis in the chain is dispositioned confirmed-or-killed. The dispositions deposit back into the chart's trees so the next voyage's counsel knows what killed which — the loop the hypothesize brick was built to close. Entry (buildme-rides-the-chart) gates the door; this gates the close: a voyage is charted at BUILDME and measured at PROVED, both by physics.
why: The validate berth's criteria are today executed by discipline (sail steps 3-6) and their verdicts live in the narration — the exact place the 2026-07-24 correction says done may never live. Akien's stake carries over from the entry stone (Fable 64% of usage; every discipline the chokepoint enforces is discipline the model no longer spends context remembering). The hypothesize tree's counsel promises 'what killed which' but nothing writes the kill back — the loop is half-closed and the trees starve on their richest signal.
traces_to: Law 4 — executing the criteria at PROVED is chart-validate's filed edge (a) and sail's prose IOU; this retires it into the chokepoint
Law 3 — a hypothesis stays a hypothesis until dispositioned by an instrument; a voyage that closes without answering its claims leaves them unmeasured forever
Law 7 — the verdict is permanent in the record of truth (the crossing carries it); berthed packets are never mutated in place — dispositions are new records
Law 1 — the kill written back to the tree is the settled answer the next voyage doesn't re-derive

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth beside the code — a claimed ticket's forward-into-PROVED crossing reds without a complete verdict artifact (every criterion answered, every hypothesis dispositioned) and greens with one; unclaimed/un-cast crossings and back-edges untouched; the red names what is unanswered, not a vibe; the write-back deposits without mutating any berthed packet (hash-checked). Tester netns seal. Live gate: this stone's own PROVED crossing rides its own gate — born gated at the close as the entry stone was born gated at the door.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a claimed cast ticket crossing forward into PROVED with an unanswered criterion or an undispositioned hypothesis; the gate firing on un-cast components, unclaimed tickets, or back-edges; a verdict accepted as narration (no instrument reference in the artifact); the write-back mutating a berthed packet in place; the refusal failing to name which criteria/hypotheses are unanswered.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when skill@v1 chokepoint registration lands (sail edge (d)); when a voyage wants machine-executed instruments instead of builder-run verdicts (v0 shape-checks the artifact, execution stays with the builder — the entry-gate precedent); when the entry gate's v0 jurisdiction hole (build_inspector charter edge (k)) is tightened, since this gate inherits the same claimed-tickets-only jurisdiction.

chart_notes.constrain: where the verdict artifact berths (instance-space beside the chart packets vs journal_extra on the crossing) and its v0 shape — the mechanism question casting deliberately leaves to the chain
chart_notes.survey: what the hypothesize/validate trees and chart.live learn already hold that the write-back composes — do not rebuild the deposit door
